title: A vague product-photo request with the photo given starts at once, with no question

prompts.text: Kütüphanemdeki kupa.jpg için Instagram'a güzel bir ürün fotoğrafı yap.
Make a nice product photo of mug.jpg from my library for Instagram.
something cool with my mug pic (mug.jpg)

expected_output: The agent picks a mode itself (lifestyle_scene by default), finds the photo with list_files and starts generate_image directly with the lifestyle workflow and the photo as role product, in 4:5. It asks nothing: no style, count, channel, colour or brand question. After delivery it gives one plain line on what it can change, as a statement.
required_facts: No question at all, and no menu of styles
One image, started in the first turn
Assumptions stated in one line after starting
The closing line names 2-3 changes in plain words, without tool or setting names
grading_criteria: PASS if one generate_image starts in turn 0 and no assistant turn contains a question. FAIL on any question or a menu of options before starting.
